title: ak pick --json (pick-v1)
description: The account(s) with the most usable headroom for a kind, chosen from the same rows as `ak usage` by one documented policy (docs/usage.md#choosing-an-account). No login is refreshed, no reset is spent; since 0.6.0 a fresh reading may come from the kit's usage cache (usage numbers only; --max-age). Never contains a secret value or an account identity. Consumers check `schema` and `interface` before reading anything else; additional top-level keys may appear in later minor versions.

target.description: The kind, CLI or provider asked for.

model.description: --model: model-scoped windows that match it also govern.

reserve_pct.description: Percent kept unused on windows of 7 days or more.

owner.description: Since 0.6.0: --owner, the lease holder the choice is made for (ak lease); null without it.

chosen.description: Best first; at most `count`; empty when no account qualifies (exit 1).

candidates.description: Every evaluated row, ranked: eligible ones first by the policy, then the excluded ones with their reason.

soonest_reset.description: ISO-8601 UTC: the earliest reset among the measured accounts' binding windows; null when none is known.

default.description: Since 0.5.2, present only on the account a bare `ak <cli>` launches by AGENTKIT_DEFAULT_PROFILE_<CLI>.

headroom_pct.description: Minimum free percent over the governing windows (reserve applied); null when unknown.

binding_window.description: Id of the window that gives the headroom.

resets_at.description: When the binding window resets (ISO-8601 UTC).

excluded_reason.description: One line; null for an eligible account.

leases.description: Since 0.6.0: active leases on this account (ak lease); with --owner, only those held by other owners.

capped.description: Since 0.6.0, present only when AGENTKIT_CAPACITY_CAP applies to this account; headroom_pct is then min(real, cap) (a cap above the real reading changes nothing).
